observations.title: Open and browse screenshots in-game
observations.player_action: Use the title/pause-menu viewer button or its configured hotkey, then click a thumbnail.
observations.outcome: A screenshot enlarges and the wheel or side controls navigate through captures.
conditions: The viewer displays existing screenshots; it does not prove a gameplay achievement shown within them.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
